name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses correctly capture 'Reach the exit' as `Existence(at_exit)` hard, 'The box must be carried when reaching the exit' as `Response(at_exit, holding_box)` hard (requiring `holding_box` at/after the last `at_exit`), and 'Whenever the box falls, pick it up in the very next step' as `ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box)` hard. The machine topology and rewards match these requirements.
